selection: per scenario: sorted target_id[::2], first 10 (each keeps its 1k/8k/32k rows)

tokenizer.semantics: messages: chat_template(add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=True) + special tokens; text: encode(add_special_tokens=True); validated against oMLX /v1/tokenize cache

accept_rule: integer token counts: floor(0.95*target) <= tokens <= floor(1.05*target) (1K lower bound is 972, not 972.8; fixes the previous 0.8-token false rejection)
tokens_semantics: tokens = messages + tools (messages_tokens + tools_tokens); messages use the reference chat template, tools are counted as their JSON text

construction_rules.document_prefix: one LongBench v2 document per target; 1K/8K/32K take a prefix slice of that document; question/options are appended unchanged. Workload-shape probe, not answerability-guaranteed.
construction_rules.document_prefix_with_search_tools: same as document_prefix, plus fixed search/lookup tool schemas counted in tokens; one request, tools are not executed in performance mode.
construction_rules.target_document_first: 1K slices the target's own dureader document; 8K/32K concatenate the target document first, then other same-task documents, and slice to the target length.
construction_rules.instruction_pool: target IFEval instruction is appended after a reference block built from other IFEval prompts (same dataset, target excluded).
construction_rules.solved_examples: target GSM8K problem is appended after solved examples drawn from the same split, excluding the 20 target problems.
construction_rules.function_catalog: target BFCL request plus a catalogue of complete, JSON-Schema-normalised function definitions ordered target-functions-first, then same-category, then the rest; filled by whole functions only (never truncated mid-JSON). The catalogue is a prefix of a shared 642-function pool, not the full pool.

window_requirements.note: Runtime window check is declared_tokens + max_tokens + context_safety_margin + decode_guard_reserve. A 32,768-token window can only host declared tokens <= 32526; the remaining 32K rows are reported as not-testable (summary.skipped), never truncated. Declared tokens exclude the decode guard.
